snippets: Xsight Labs is a fabless semiconductor company specializing in end-to-end connectivity solutions for AI factories, hyperscale data centers, cloud infrastructure, edge inference, and traditional compute and networking.[1][2][3] Headquartered in Israel with offices in Armenia and the United States, it employs around 200 people and targets AI and cloud service providers by delivering high-bandwidth, low-latency products that reduce power demands and total cost of ownership.[1][2] Its mission is to set new standards in performance, scalability, and efficiency for next-generation hyperscale cloud and generative AI data centers, with a vision of a democratized ecosystem of silicon, software, and systems.[1][2]
Xsight Labs is a technology company.

Xsight Labs develops silicon for high-performance networking and data processing in cloud and hyperscale data centers. Its portfolio includes programmable X-series switches and E-series data processing units. These solutions prioritize open, efficient, software-defined infrastructure, delivering performance per watt and flexibility.

Founded 2017 by Erez Shaizaf, Gal Malach, and Guy Koren, Xsight Labs emerged from their EZchip experience. Koren (former CEO), Shaizaf (ex-Switch product line GM), and Malach (former CTO) recognized architectural gaps in networking silicon.
